title: Consultor SAP FI/CO Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga


Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.


Sobre a vaga

Requisitos

  • Ter profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócios de SAP Finance e de como a solução funciona
  • Ter bom conhecimento de como executar processos de SAP Finance, incluindo tabelas e configuração do sistema
  • Responder aos chamados (tickets) em tempo hábil e dar suporte aos usuários-chave de SAP na área de especialização
  • Interagir com os usuários para identificar e investigar problemas, explicar regras funcionais e técnicas do SAP e apresentar soluções
  • Monitorar interfaces SAP e resolver ou encaminhar erros encontrados
  • Identificar, analisar e tratar problemas e suas causas raiz para questões recorrentes (entrega de CSIs)
  • Aplicar customizações padrão SAP (correções de bugs, mudanças rotineiras e não rotineiras), realizar testes e manter a documentação da solução
  • Entregar pequenas melhorias (levantar requisitos de negócio, preparar DAB e FSD, trabalhar com desenvolvedores e garantir testes e documentação adequados antes da entrada em produção)
  • Apoiar outros colegas na equipe global de AMS
  • Aprofundar continuamente o conhecimento em processos de negócio e soluções técnicas
  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da equipe de suporte SAP, mantendo documentações úteis para o trabalho diário e expertise da equipe
  • Garantir a execução dos Indicadores-Chave de Performance (KPIs) em tempo hábil
  • Assegurar um relacionamento de trabalho positivo com usuários, colegas, funcionários e contratados


Formação / Experiência

  • Graduação em TI, Finanças / Contabilidade, Administração ou equivalente
  • Experiência com faturas, provisões (accruals), lançamentos contábeis em SAP, pagamentos, extratos bancários, bancos da empresa (house banks), dados mestres relacionados, VIM, etc.


Idiomas

  • Inglês (fluente, escrito e falado)
  • Português
  • Espanhol é um diferencial

Competências de Negócio

  • Excelente conhecimento e entendimento de processos de negócio em SAP Finance – Faturamento & Caixa (SAP AP, AR e integração de dados financeiros)
  • Experiência com lançamentos, compensações, estornos, etc., e integrações com outros sistemas como OCR e Vendor Invoice Management
  • Experiência com suporte a usuários SAP
  • Experiência com relatórios SAP BI é um diferencial



O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Tech Recruiter
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Tech Recruiter

  • Modelo de contratação : PJ
  • Horário : Integral


Resumo da Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Recruiter para identificar, atrair e engajar talentos no mercado de tecnologia. Procuramos alguém organizado(a), proativo(a) e com olhar atento para inovação e pessoas.

Se você é curioso(a), tem afinidade com processos de recrutamento e deseja crescer em uma consultoria de tecnologia dinâmica e em expansão, queremos conhecer você. Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time!


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e atrair talentos para vagas de tecnologia utilizando Recruiter.
  • Divulgar vagas em grupos de WhatsApp, Telegram e , garantindo ampla visibilidade.
  • Realizar hunting ativo, screenings de candidatos e manter o banco de talentos atualizado.
  • Conduzir entrevistas comportamentais e acompanhar entrevistas com clientes.
  • Acompanhar métricas de recrutamento alimentando planilhas de Excel.
  • Colaborar com o time na utilização de ferramentas de IA para otimizar processos de recrutamento.
  • Propor melhorias em processos e enfrentar desafios de recrutamento com proatividade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ser formado em Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em recrutamento de tecnologia, preferencialmente em empresas tech ou consultorias.

Diferenciais

Sobre a PSW Digital

Quem somos nós?

A PSW Digital é uma consultoria especializada em Gestão de Processos e Tecnologia, com mais de 20 anos de experiência no mercado. Atendemos clientes na América Latina e Europa, ajudando empresas a digitalizar e transformar seus negócios com inovação e tecnologia de ponta.

Nossa sede está localizada no Instituto Caldeira, um dos maiores hubs de inovação e tecnologia do Brasil, situado em Porto Alegre/RS.

Atuamos em setores estratégicos como tecnologia, indústria, varejo e agronegócio, atendendo grandes empresas, incluindo Natura, Irani, Nutrien, Leroy Merlin, Dexco, Axa, Arezzo&Co, Usaflex, SLC Agrícola, Mapfre e Kepler Weber.

title: Business Operations Intern
description:
Sobre a Liora

No Brasil, a maioria das pessoas ainda não sabe que pode escolher sua energia. E, quando sabe, muitas vezes não entende ou não confia em quem oferece. Nós existimos para mudar isso.


A Liora nasceu com uma missão ousada e urgente: destravar o poder da energia. Queremos transformar a energia em um ativo financeiro que cria mais oportunidades econômicas no dia a dia das pessoas e dos negócios.


Acreditamos que o futuro da energia precisa ser mais barato, mais inteligente e mais eficiente. Para chegar lá, contamos com o apoio de 3 fundos de investimentos: Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital para construir a maior provedora de serviços de energia do país, com tecnologia de ponta e uma experiência que surpreende. Após dobrar de tamanho nos dois primeiros meses de 2026, projetamos crescer 15 vezes até o fim do ano.

(


Por que um estágio na Liora?

  • Crescimento acelerado: em pouco tempo você se vê resolvendo problemas complexos, transitando por diferentes desafios e construindo coisas que ainda não existiam quando você chegou.
  • Visão completa: você não fica preso em uma caixinha. Tem exposição a diferentes operações, lideranças e founders, participando ativamente da construção da empresa.
  • Ownership de verdade: você vai ter algo seu, do qual é 100% responsável, fazendo a diferença pra sair do papel e escalar.


Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, técnico e historicamente construído para poucos entenderem, prova disso é que a maioria dos brasileiros paga a conta de luz todo mês sem saber o que está sendo cobrado e sem conseguir avaliar se está correto.


Simplificar, tornar transparente e educar as pessoas sobre o que consomem e o que pagam, parece óbvio, mas ninguém no mercado de energia conseguiu fazer isso ainda.


Para chegar lá, existe uma complexidade intelectual enorme. Bandeira tarifária, tributos, tarifas que variam por distribuidora, por período, por tipo de cliente, são dezenas de variáveis interdependentes que precisam ser dominadas para que uma conta de luz seja gerada com precisão e clareza.


E vai além do faturamento. Essa operação é a base que viabiliza novos produtos, inovações que ainda vão mudar a forma como o mercado de energia funciona.


Seus desafios são:

  • Construir e operar o processo de faturamento
  • Garantir a gestão e conciliação de créditos de energia
  • Transformar dados em decisões: indicadores, análises e acompanhamentos
  • Automatizar e otimizar os diversos processos com uso de AI e Low Code
  • Viabilizar testes e implementações de novos produtos


Perfil que buscamos

  • Cultura AI first: já brincou com automações, LLMs ou construiu algo só porque queria ver funcionar
  • Cursando o último ou penúltimo ano de administração, economia, engenharia, estatística ou áreas afins, experiência prévia em startups e consultoria é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório
  • Analítico: não só vê os dados, enxerga padrões e soluções
  • Viés para ação: não espera o manual, prefere escrever ele
  • Confortável com pouca estrutura e ambientes em constante evolução

title: Analista de processos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos e Qualidade para atuar de forma estratégica na melhoria contínua dos nossos processos, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência operacional, a padronização das rotinas e a entrega de valor para clientes internos e externos.

Esse(a) profissional terá um papel fundamental na análise, mapeamento, redesenho e monitoramento de processos, além de apoiar a construção de indicadores, padrões de qualidade e práticas que fortaleçam a governança e a excelência operacional da organização.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Mapear, analisar e redesenhar processos organizacionais, utilizando metodologias de gestão de processos (BPM), com foco em eficiência, padronização e melhoria contínua.
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos fluxos de trabalho, propondo soluções práticas e sustentáveis.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação de processos (fluxogramas, procedimentos, manuais e instruções de trabalho).
  • Apoiar a definição, acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Atuar no suporte à implantação e manutenção de práticas e padrões de qualidade, contribuindo para a governança dos processos.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz e apoiar planos de ação corretivos e preventivos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, eficiência operacional e padronização entre áreas.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com as áreas de negócio, promovendo alinhamento, engajamento e adesão aos processos definidos.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, diagnósticos de maturidade de processos e qualidade, quando aplicável.
  • Produzir relatórios e apresentações executivas com análises, resultados e recomendações.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação acadêmica

title: HR Operations Senior Specialist
description:
About Us

Keeta is a technology-driven delivery platform that connects consumers with local food and retail merchants and couriers. Operating as an independent brand under Meituan, one of the world’s largest tech-driven retail companies, we are driven by the mission: \"Help People Eat Better, Live Better.\"

Since its founding in March 2010, Meituan has revolutionized the digital landscape, reshaping supply and demand dynamics across service and product retail through rapid growth and innovation. Keeta builds on this industry influence, bringing exceptional capabilities, swift responsiveness, and quality service to elevate the delivery sector and enhance the lives of users worldwide.

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into new markets including Brazil, Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail.

We combine Meituan’s global expertise with local innovation to deliver exceptional, customer-centric services and seamless experiences. Join Keeta as we take this success story into new markets, driving innovation, growth, and excellence.


What You'll Do

We seek an experienced HR Operations Senior Specialist to drive HR policy development, SOP creation, process optimization, and team enablement. This role ensures standardized, well-implemented HR policies and processes support business goals and compliance.

HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.
  • Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

  • Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.
  • Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

Quality Controal & Employee Experience

  • Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.
  • Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.


What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.
  • Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.
  • Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.
  • Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


What Make This Role Exciting

  • Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.
  • Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.
  • Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.
  • Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan’s global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You’ll be part of a company that’s transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you’ll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Brazil, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You’ll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let’s build the future of food delivery.

description:
Resumo do cargo:

Como Gerente de Negócios para Soluções de Medição, você será responsável pelo desempenho comercial do portfólio de Medição no território designado, impulsionando o crescimento de pedidos e margens em todas as linhas de produto (Coriolis, medidor magnético, Vortex, medidor ultrassônico não intrusivo e Roxar).


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Liderar o desempenho comercial das Soluções de Medição, impulsionando crescimento sustentável de pedidos, receita e margem.
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de vendas territorial alinhado aos objetivos regionais e à estratégia do negócio.
  • Orquestrar o modelo de cobertura comercial (vendas diretas e canais), garantindo foco nos segmentos verticais prioritários.
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, elevando a qualificação, previsibilidade e taxas de conversão, com disciplina no uso de CRM.
  • Identificar oportunidades na base instalada e expandir a oferta de serviços, contratos e soluções digitais.
  • Construir relacionamentos com clientes-chave, influenciadores e tomadores de decisão, posicionando a Emerson como parceira estratégica.
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com equipes internas (Aplicação, Serviços, Marketing, Operações, Finanças) para oferecer propostas competitivas e de alto valor.
  • Desenvolver canais de vendas por meio de metas, treinamentos, acompanhamento de performance e engajamento contínuo.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado e concorrência, trazendo insights para estratégia e decisões comerciais.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de ética, segurança e governança da Emerson.

Quem você é:

Você combina pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes. Toma decisões ancoradas em dados, mantendo foco nas prioridades e orientando ações para gerar impacto mensurável.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência significativa em vendas consultivas B2B, desenvolvimento de negócios ou gestão de contas em indústrias de processo.
  • Conhecimento sólido de instrumentação e Soluções de Medição (Coriolis, medidor magnético, Vortex, medidor ultrassônico não intrusivo e Roxar).
  • Vivência em gestão de território e/ou canais de vendas.
  • Capacidade de análise de pipeline e indicadores comerciais utilizando ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro do território.
  • Capacidade de comunicação em Inglês para interação com materiais, sistemas e equipes globais.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Experiência prévia com soluções Emerson ou portfólio de instrumentação e automação.
  • Vivência consolidada na gestão de canais (distribuidores, representantes, integradores).
  • Experiência em venda de serviços, soluções digitais e IIoT.
  • Familiaridade com os principais segmentos industriais da região.
  • Espanhol.
  • Histórico consistente de superação de metas comerciais com foco em margem e valor agregado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

Atuará como agente de mudança, gerenciando transformações organizacionais e assegurando que os resultados esperados sejam alcançados. Outra parte fundamental de sua missão será promover a proposta de valor ao empregado, estimulando o engajamento e a comunicação, a fim de posicionar a empresa como a escolha ideal de carreira. Você será um especialista em políticas e processos de RH, trabalhando em colaboração com os Centros de Excelência em áreas como planejamento de força de trabalho, recrutamento, remuneração, gestão de desempenho e desenvolvimento, além de sistemas de informação de RH (HRIS), garantindo a entrega de serviços eficazes. Sua função também incluirá gerenciar e resolver questões complexas de relações trabalhistas, conduzindo investigações detalhadas. Você deverá se manter atualizado sobre as legislações pertinentes, minimizando riscos legais e assegurando a conformidade regulatória, colaborando com o departamento jurídico quando necessário. No ManpowerGroup, a sua carreira tem um novo rumo! Se você está em busca de crescimento, desafios e um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial, venha fazer parte do nosso time. Aqui, cada talento é reconhecido e valorizado.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your  profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Engenheiro (a) de IA (DevEx) Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga

A área é responsável por conduzir processos seletivos alinhados aos valores e à cultura da B3, garantindo uma experiência positiva para os candidatos. Além disso, colaboramos com os gestores para identificar necessidades específicas de recrutamento e propor soluções assertivas.


O que esperamos da sua atuação

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software (nível sênior), atuando em backend ou full stack;
  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem moderna de backend (por exemplo, Python, Java, C#, Node.js);
  • Experiência com APIs REST, serviços distribuídos e práticas de DevOps/DevEx (CI/CD, automação, observabilidade);
  • Vivência prática com IA generativa ou LLMs (uso de APIs de modelos, chatbots, assistentes, RAG ou similar);
  • Foco em experiência do desenvolvedor e ganho de produtividade;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com diferentes times;
  • Autonomia, senso de dono e capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta;
  • Abertura à experimentação, aprendizado contínuo e uso responsável de IA;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de engenharia: testes automatizados, revisão de código, design de sistemas e documentação técnica.

description:
Role Summary


We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.


The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.


Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.


Responsibilities


• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.


• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.


• Present the company’s preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.


• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.


• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.


• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.


• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.


• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.


• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.


• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.


Qualifications

Skills


• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).

• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.

• Strong organization and time management skills.

• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.

• Fast and accurate typing skills.


Experience


• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.


• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.


• Experience working with U.S. customers or international support teams is a plus.


Work Requirements


• Quiet and professional home office environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

title: Senior.NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

description:

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.

The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.

  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.

Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, and Event Bridge.
Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or Type Script for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e. G. JIRA, Browser Stack).
Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. We offer
We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;
Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;
Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;
Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;
Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P& IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;
Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced English;
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;
Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.
Nice to have
Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.
Benefits

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.

100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.

Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.

Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience

title: Business development manager/director
description:
Ping Pong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300 B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world's leading cross-border platforms – and we're just getting started.
Ping Pong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.
Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.
WHAT' S THE CHALLENGE?
You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You'll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You've got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.
WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH
You'll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You'll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next. WHAT YOU BRING
Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams. WHO YOU ARE
Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Customer-focused, you can't imagine working in any other way, and it's the only way to achieve our goals.
Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders Ping Pong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.
We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Electrical engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer
Location: Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;
Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;
Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;
Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;
Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P& IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;
Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced English;
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;
Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.
Nice to have
Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Marketing & product designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at Project Mark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.
We're looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets
Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints. Help Center & Education Content
Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases. Marketing & Growth Design
Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently. Website & Conversion Optimization
Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind. Sales & Operations Enablement
Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed. Product Design Support
Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces. Asset Management & Brand Consistency
Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team. What We're Looking For
Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
Advanced or fluent English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications
Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience designing within a B2 B Saa S environment.
Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems. Nice-to-Have Skills
Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
Experience with Hub Spot (emails, templates, workflows).
Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.). Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Full-time social ads specialist
description:
About Us
Blue Tuskr is a U. S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.
What You'll Do
As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.
Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to Linked In, Pinterest, and Tik Tok.
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.
This role requires a strong understanding of post-i OS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.
More specifically, in this role you will:
Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!
